confidence_notes: The RBA rate is the 18 November 2026 observation found through search. Food and beer anchors rest on 3 searches. Those results were aggregated cost-of-living sources dated roughly 2023-2025, and they varied widely. Tulum is a tourist-inflated market, so I set the figures toward the upper-middle of the ranges found. I found no reliable Tulum cocktail or wine price. Cocktail and wine are set from the local relationship to beer and from tourist-zone venue prices, so they are uncertain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Tulum as a high-priced beach destination. I did not search for or inspect any listings. Tulum hotel and hostel prices vary a lot by season and by location (town, beach road or jungle).
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Mexican Caribbean resort destinations such as Playa del Carmen and Cancun, with Tulum priced a little above the Mexican average. The beach zone is notably more expensive than the town.
